title: Weekly product sync
lines: Morning everyone. Let's get started, we've got a lot to cover before the launch. Raj, do you want to begin with the release status?
Sure. The release candidate went out to the beta group on Monday. We've had about three hundred people install it so far.
Crash rates are low, under half a percent, but there's one issue with the sync on older tablets that we need to fix.
How serious is the tablet issue?
It only happens when the battery saver is on. The sync stops in the background and doesn't resume until you open the app.
That sounds like the background limits changed in the last system update.
Yes, exactly, that's our theory too. I think we can work around it, but it'll take a few days.
Okay. Is that a blocker for the launch on the twentieth?
I don't think so. It affects maybe two percent of users, and they don't lose any data. It just syncs later.
From the support side, I'd rather we ship with a known issue than delay. We can put a note in the help centre.
Agreed. Let's keep the launch date of October the twentieth, and treat the tablet sync as a fast follow.
Okay, I'll plan the fix for the first patch release.
James, where are we on the marketing assets?
The landing page is done and the screenshots are being updated this week. The launch video is the one I'm worried about.
The agency sent the first cut yesterday and it uses the old onboarding screens. They need the new ones from design.
If they get the new screens by Thursday, they can still deliver the final version by the fifteenth.
Who owns getting them the screens?
That's me. I'll get the exported screens from the design team and send them over by Thursday.
Great. Niamh, how is support preparing for the launch?
We've written twelve new help articles, and the team has done two training sessions on the new features.
My main concern is staffing. Last launch, our ticket volume tripled in the first week.
Do we have extra people lined up?
Two people from the sales team volunteered to help with the chat queue. I'd like one more, ideally someone technical.
I could lend you one of the engineers for the first three days. Maybe Tom, he knows the sync code really well.
That would be brilliant, thank you.
Good. Raj, can you confirm with Tom this week?
Next, budget. We're about fifteen thousand dollars over on the launch budget, mostly because of the video.
Some of that is the reshoot. The original agency quote didn't include the second day of filming.
Can we cover it from the events budget? The conference in December was cancelled.
I think so, but finance needs to approve moving the money.
Then I'll raise it with finance on Friday. If they say no, we'll cut the paid social campaign instead.
Can I ask one question about the launch day itself? Are we doing the announcement in the morning or the afternoon?
That's not decided yet. The press team wants the morning, but our users are mostly in the US, so the afternoon might be better.
From an engineering view, the morning is better. If something goes wrong, we have the whole day to fix it.
That's a fair point. Let's leave it open for now, and I'll decide with the press team by Monday.
Okay, let me summarise. Launch stays on the twentieth. Raj fixes the tablet sync in the first patch and confirms Tom for support.
James sends the new screens to the agency by Thursday. I'll talk to finance on Friday and decide the announcement time by Monday.
And I'll publish the help articles the day before launch.
Perfect. Thanks everyone, same time next week.
